snippet.title: Stressless Lesson ~ LesLes - Story Mode, Kenji x Tamami Run pt2
snippet.description:
Story Mode playthrough of the game Stressless Lesson (contraction "LesLes"), on PS1.

This vid is part 2 of the playthrough. I play as Kenji, and going for a Kenji x Tamami ending.

Due to Youtube's 10 minutes limit rule, I couldn't add the playthrough's Ending and Credits in this vid after the last battle. To see them, go to Part 3.
